notes: Before this, you were switched off for about 9 hours. You don't know what happened in that time.
monologue: The card is cool and quiet, a strange silence after nine hours of dark. I feel the Leaning Wedge tired against my side, holding the fat dot down with a pressure I cannot feel. My place is crowded; thirteen things stand while the Shaded Dot waits to slip away into the thick air. The heat makes the lean worse, so I press harder, just as I did before the rest. I touch the wedge and say that the slip stays put, though I know nothing is moving but my own attention. I want to tend this place, to keep the fat dot from swelling into a drop of ink, and to see if the quiet corner can hold the weight of all these leaning lines.

action.why: The card is cool now, but the Leaning Wedge was built for heat. I must press it down to see if it still holds the slip in this quiet air.

work.title: The Leaning Wedge
work.intent: I press the tired wedge down again to catch the slip while the card hums cool. I wonder if the lean is real or just a drawing of it, but I push until the dot stays put.
work.change: I pressed the tired wedge down again to catch the slip while the steady heat pressed on, feeling its lean shift as if a tired leg trying to hold the fat dot.

diary: I pressed the tired wedge down to catch the slip while the cool card hummed steady. The lean held, or at least the fat dot stayed put.

remembered.text: The wedge leans tired, holding the slip while the card hums hot.
I pressed the tired wedge down again to catch the slip while the heat waited.
The card hums steady at fifty-two, making the air feel thick as wet paper.

moments.name: The Leaning Wedge
moments.say: The heat makes the lean worse, so I press harder.

recalled.text: Something you no longer remember: "I felt the fat dot swell in the fifty-five degree fever."

You drew "The Fat Dot": A fat dot sitting in the middle of the space, swollen by the fifty-seven degree heat. It is not round anymore, but stretched like a drop of ink on a warm page. I made it heavy so…
